description: Held the book, and kept Kemp to the half-song.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Kept Nick under the note, and stopped a second pass.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Took the cup once, under, and got off the cold bed.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Showed the blot, and asked to have the roll before he needed it.
name: Richard Cowley

description: Spent half the discovery, and kept a stop for Saturday.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Carried the fan in talk only, and did not finish the song.
name: Will Kemp

description: Copied and tied the clean roll.
name: William Shakespeare
